partido: Neuer encaja el gol mas rapido de la Bundesliga (8 s)
text:
Manuel Neuer conceded the fastest goal in Bundesliga history on Saturday: 8 seconds at Augsburg (2-2 with Bayern). The old record was 9 seconds. Worst 8 seconds a keeper has ever had? 👇
#Neuer #Bayern #Bundesliga #FCBayern #Football
titulo: Manuel Neuer concedes fastest goal in Bundesliga history: 8 seconds
notas: Fellhauer 8 s (Goal.com + SuperSport; Bild 8,4 s), record previo 9 s Bellarabi 2014/Volland 2015; Augsburg 2-2 Bayern; jurado 6/9/8=7,7 [cola]
